en: The postcard depicts a scenic rural landscape with a prominent steel bridge crossing a river. There is a steamboat visible under steam next to the bridge, several buildings along the riverbank, and a forested hillside in the background. The image is sepia-toned, indicating an older photograph. The text 'Parti från Bergeforsen' is printed in the top right corner of the image. The reverse side has a typical divided-back design for address and message, with the logo 'SVENSKA LITOGRAFISKA AB STOCKHOLM' printed at the bottom.
